The preview uses Juniper’s gateway and requires no provider key.’ Can I use it without paying or entering a provider key?

scenarios.title: Two tickets within a budget
scenarios.notes: Miniature Worlds ($41) and Blue Room Quartet ($40 when booked Thursday). Courtyard Films ($43) and Late Gallery ($42.50) exceed the budget. Print Fair starts before 7 p.m.

messages.content:
Which of these events could two of us go to this Saturday for at most $42 total? We can't arrive before 7 p.m. We can book today, which is Thursday. Here are the listings.

Courtyard Films, 7:30 p.m. — $18 each plus $3.50 per ticket.
Miniature Worlds, 8 p.m. — $19 each plus $3 per order.
Blue Room Quartet, 7 p.m. — $18 each plus a $4 per ticket weekend surcharge.
Late Gallery, 9 p.m. — $16 each plus a $10.50 fee per order.
Print Fair, 6:45 p.m. — $18 each with no fee.
The amounts above include all charges.
Miniature Worlds is the only option at $41 total. Blue Room Quartet is $44 because the $4 weekend surcharge applies to each ticket.

Blue Room's box office note says ‘For a Saturday performance, bookings placed by Friday at noon pay one $4 surcharge per order, regardless of the number of tickets.’ Which events actually fit our arrival time and $42 total when we book today?
